publications: [{"title":"Cellular Uptake of 2-Aminopyridine-Modified Peptide Nucleic Acids Conjugated with Cell-Penetrating Peptides","subtitle":"Biopolymers","date":"December 16, 2021","description":"Cell-penetrating peptides (CPPs) have been extensively used to deliver peptide nucleic acid (PNA) in cells. We have previously found that replacement of cytosine in triplex-forming PNAs with 2-aminopyridine (M) not only enhanced RNA binding, but also improved cellular uptake of PNAs. In this study, we used confocal fluorescence microscopy to evaluate the ability of CPPs to further improve cellular uptake of M-modified PNAs. We found that PNAs conjugated with Tat and octa-arginine peptides were effectively taken up in MCF7 cells when supplied in cell media at 1 μM. Remarkably, M-modified PNA without any CPP conjugation also showed strong uptake when the concentration was increased to 5 μM. Majority of PNA conjugates remained localized in distinct cytoplasmic vesicles, as judged by dot-like fluorescence patterns. However, M-modified PNAs conjugated with Tat, octa-arginine, and even a simple tri-lysine peptide also showed dispersed fluorescence in cytoplasm and were taken up in nuclei where they localized in larger vesicles, most likely nucleoli. Endosomolytic peptides or chemicals (chloroquine and CaCl2) did not release the conjugates from cytosolic vesicles, which suggested that the PNAs were not entrapped in endosomes. about: I’m a technology strategist and CEO who leverages AI, crypto, blockchain, and emerging technologies to help leaders cut through the noise, build sticky communities, and drive lasting engagement. Over the past 20 years, I’ve been at the cutting edge of interactive media—from shaping mobile experiences at Disney and pioneering digital-release films at Warner Bros with Netflix, to uniting gamers and brands at Warner Games and launching League of Legends Season 2’s inaugural esports tournaments at Riot Games. Along the way, I founded Double A Events to produce large-scale activations, immersive Augmented reality concerts, VR game launches and cutting edge mobile apps. Highlights include a Katy Perry video game, The Friends App (Millions downloaded), and Blizzard’s Villain-Con, among hundreds of other high-impact projects. Today, as Founder and CEO of Double A Labs, I lead a SaaS platform that empowers brands, creators, and educators to build, gamify, and monetize community-driven experiences. With over 1,000 immersive events and 450 million engagements across XR, AR, digital storytelling, video gaming, and immersive communities, we know how to make your brand go viral. Let’s connect to explore how AI-powered immersive experiences can transform your community engagement. In addition I am an active board member at University of Texas's Game Development and Design Program, the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT), the Raiden Science Foundation and YPO (Young Presidents Organization). www.doublealabs.com https://amberdallen.com

about: 🚗 About AutoSeek.us AutoSeek.us is a next-generation used car recommendation platform built by a Silicon Valley startup team. Leveraging AI and transparent data, we help consumers discover the most value-for-money vehicles based on real condition and need. We are ESG-driven: committed to sustainability, vehicle reuse, and integrating technology to reduce automotive waste. Our parent company, CarSal Labs, has participated in government and nonprofit environmental initiatives. CarSal.com is a next-generation vehicle resale platform based in Silicon Valley. We specialize in professionally inspected, lightly damaged vehicles—often referred to as “rebuilt title cars” by DMV —that are undervalued by the traditional market but still have high driving and resale value. We believe that transparency, trust, and technology are the future of used car buying. Through our AI-powered platform and ESG-driven mission, CarSal helps consumers discover cars that are safe, affordable, and smart long-term investments. 💡 What Makes Us Different? Transparent Vehicle Ratings Every vehicle comes with a professional inspection, third-party reports (e.g., AutoCheck, VinAudit), and a clear condition summary—no hidden damage or surprises. Smart Price-Value Match We use proprietary tools to evaluate a vehicle’s actual worth based on condition, repair potential, and resale history—often helping buyers save 30–50% compared to new or clean-title cars. ESG-Driven Reuse Model By reintroducing lightly damaged cars back into circulation, we help reduce industrial waste, maximize resource efficiency, and promote a circular automotive economy. Buy with Confidence Many of our listings include optional warranty support, post-sale assistance, and a 7-day return policy for qualified purchases. 🌍 Our Mission To make buying a used car safer, smarter, and more sustainable, by giving a second life to quality vehicles and empowering consumers with data, tools, and trust.

about: From the bustling design studios of Parsons to the joyful chaos of a children's upcycling workshop, my journey has been a decade-long exploration of fashion's potential beyond the new. My name is Olga Singh, and I'm the founder of 05:REDESIGN. My mission is to show that a more creative and sustainable relationship with our clothes is not only possible, but also incredibly fun. My story began with a love for knitwear and a world-class education from both Parsons in New York and the British Higher School of Art & Design. After years working in the industry, I witnessed firsthand the environmental impact of fast fashion. This experience fueled a desire to do things differently. I found my true calling not in designing new garments, but in giving old ones a second life. 05:REDESIGN was born from this passion. We started with workshops for children, teaching them not just to sew, but to see the potential in every forgotten t-shirt and pair of jeans. It's been a truly rewarding experience to watch their creativity blossom as they turn old clothes into unique new treasures. Now, I'm ready to bring this same energy to an adult audience. My vision is to create engaging, hands-on workshops where adults can learn valuable upcycling skills, connect with their creativity, and build a more sustainable wardrobe, all while having a great time. To make this a reality, I'm actively seeking partnerships with unique and inspiring venues in New York City.

name: Yasiris Gomez
about: 👋 Hi, I'm Yasiris /ya·see·ris/, also known as Yosiris /yo·see·ris/, a multidisciplinary designer and accessibility advocate from the Dominican Republic. With a newly earned master's degree in Interaction Design and a specialization in High-Tech Entrepreneurship from Harbour.Space University, I’m passionate about using design to create inclusive experiences that empower everyone, especially those with disabilities. 🦻 As a Deaf/Hard of Hearing designer, I bring a unique perspective to the table, focusing on breaking down barriers through thoughtful design and technology. My mission is to make the digital and physical worlds more accessible and user-friendly for all. 🏆 Over the years, I've been honored with accolades like an honorable mention at Startup Weekend Santo Domingo 2022 for my Labor Inclusion project and winning 1st place in the INTEC Emprende Business Idea Pre-Incubation Program 2023 for Inclusive Education for Deaf Individuals. These experiences have fueled my commitment to social impact through design and technology. 💡 My multidisciplinary expertise spans UX Research, UI Design, Product Design, Industrial Design, Visual Branding, and Project Management. I’m skilled in industry-standard tools like Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Solidworks, Fusion 360, and basic HTML/CSS, all of which I use to turn ideas into impactful solutions. 🌍 I’m deeply invested in Design Thinking, User-Centered Design, and Universal Design, always striving to address real-world challenges with creativity and empathy. 📚 Interested in my thoughts on design, entrepreneurship, or accessibility? Check out my Personal Blog (https://yasirisgomez.medium.com/), follow my ongoing projects on Deaf PWR's Instagram (@deafpwr_rd), and view my portfolio at yasirisgomez.com. Let’s connect and explore how we can collaborate to make a difference!

about: I founded What The Fail with the intention to change the way we relate with "failure" in our society. As Asians, there is a lot of shame related to failing but how can there be innovation and moving forward in life if we don't try new things and learn from the experience? At What The Fail, entrepreneurs and thought leaders get unfiltered and vulnerable about the moments in their life where they dared to try new things and have failed spectacularly. I am the Founder of ClockOut; a project that came to fruition at the end of 2016 when I realized that most of us are caught up in the rat-race and barely had any time to pause to breathe. After suffering from burn-outs myself, I realized that it was essential for us to take time to reflect and actively confront issues in our lives. ClockOut aims to create safe spaces for our community to ‘clockout’ from life, contemplate on issues via carefully curated questions, and forge authentic connections with people in our lives. I also used to organise F**KUp Nights Singapore, part of global movement where speakers share their biggest business failures in the most honest and candid manner. This is because we believe in showcasing the grit and resilience it takes to run a startup, or organisation behind all the glamour. I have 11 years of experience in marketing and community building, and I strongly believe that investing into building an engaged community is key to delivering business outcomes. Let's chat over coffee on what it takes to build a sustainable community strategy, how to build a more conscious life, or how we have both failed at something :)

about: I’m a curious and purpose-driven multipotentialite from Myanmar, navigating life at the intersection of entrepreneurship, education, and marketing tech. Whether building a startup or mastering a new tool, I’m always chasing one thing — impact. Since 19, I’ve been diving into the world of startups — so far co-founding two ventures, including Thate Pan Hub, a non-profit EdTech social enterprise empowering 20,000+ learners with inclusive quality education. I’ve led youth organization with 300+ members and worked in a tech startup as a test automation engineer — where I realized I was more drawn to business strategy than coding. Now, I’m studying entrepreneurship and digital marketing while exploring how marketing technology can help businesses grow smarter and faster. I’m not selling services (yet), but I share case studies, insights, and real lessons from my journey to connect with others who care about purposeful innovation. Personality-wise? I lead with care, adapt quickly, and bring humor and heart into everything I do — plus a solid karaoke voice. My path hasn’t been linear, but it’s mine, and I’m proud of every twist. If you’re in startups, martech, or education — let’s connect. 💌

about: I ignite growth by driving innovation and new ventures in established organisations. My teams and I work intentionally to redefine the customer experience, address health inequities, increase access to innovative solutions and create products and services that help end users lead happier and healthier lives. I build the right structures, alliances, capabilities and teams to enable “always on” transformation, drive entrepreneurial behavior and continuous discovery. ►g.berezhnov@gmail.com I’ve built a deep capacity for innovation in organizations and enabled the design and delivery of holistic disease management systems from advanced diagnostics to rehabilitation and affordability programs. Subsequently, I’ve scaled several products and services from market entry to prominent market solutions. This not only drove financial performance but profoundly changed the customer experience and shaped the healthcare landscape. THOUGHT LEADERSHIP I challenge the status quo. My perspective is driven by an entrepreneurial outlook, thoughtful market analysis and human centricity. I believe that sustaining profitable growth in today’s world requires continuous transformation, innovation and capacity to uncover and build new growth engines. This has been one of my greatest contributions to date. DIVERSE TEAMS -> DIVERSE IDEAS My teams are diverse in education, culture and industries. This feeds a dynamic atmosphere where ideas flow and discovery is a regular occurrence. I value ownership, openness and continuous experimentation. I lead with purpose, laying out why we do what we do and what the meaningful outcomes are. This, in turn, leads to inspired and fulfilled leaders designing meaningful, human-centric solutions. CONTINUOUS TRANSFORMATION How can we make the organization more agile and responsive? This is the strategic mindset I bring to the company. I look for ways to shift culture, optimize processes and make the company leaner by assessing what needs to change. During projects, initiatives and strategies I’ve developed, I’ve always thought more broadly and sought to enable change to support the company’s objectives. BUILDING ALLIANCES With an ability to clarify ambiguity and simplify the complex, I’ve built trust by providing a clear outline of strategies, goals and outcomes. I’ve created critical market alliances, established strategic partnerships and assembled multi-disciplinary, cross-functional teams. Let’s discuss development of market-leading products and services, human-centered design, daring organizations and teams committed to innovation.

publications: [{"title":"New product development process and case studies for deep-tech academic research to commercialization","subtitle":"Journal of Innovation and Entrepreneurship","date":"July 17, 2023","description":"This research proposes a new product development (NPD) framework for innovation-driven deep-tech research to commercialization and tested it with three case studies of different exploitation methods. The proposed framework, called Augmented Stage-Gate, integrates the next-generation Agile Stage-Gate development process with lean startup and design thinking approaches. The framework consists of six stages and five gates and focuses on critical thinking to help entrepreneurs avoid psychological traps and make the right decisions. Early activities focus on scouting for potential socioeco-nomically impactful deep-tech research, developing a business case, market analysis, and strategy for problem-solution fit, and then, moving to a build-measure-learn activity with a validated learning feedback loop. Next, suitable exploitation methods are decided using weight factor analysis, developing intellectual property (IP) strategy, completing the university technology transfer process, and participating in fundrais-ing. To pass each gate, the committee board members, consisting of tech, business, IP and regulatory, and domain experts, will evaluate the passing criteria to decide Go/ No-Go. Applying the framework to the case studies results in successful university research commercialization. The model, case study, and lessons learned in this paper can be useful for other deep-tech incubator programs to successfully launch deep-tech research for commercialization. The case studies' positive outcomes validate the Augmented Stage-Gate framework, yet their success is not entirely guaranteed due to external factors like regulatory constraints, entrepreneur characteristics, timing, and the necessary ecosystem or infrastructure, particularly in emerging markets. about: Being a Visionary Healthcare Data Solutions Leader has been so.... AMAZING! Look at what I get to do! 35+ years building inspirational cross-functional teams that break down silos through intention and purpose. Rolling up our sleeves, getting dirty with Big Data and Advanced Analytics, and creating value-based solutions, we've changed the landscape for the most pressing issues in commercial pharma. Solving Big Healthcare's challenges - 8 of the top 10 Big Pharma companies, 11 of the top 15 Pharmacies, and all Big Distributors - led to innovative insights that helped shape and hone ever-evolving business strategies. When companies understand their customers' needs, are able to connect with customers, and can provide a resonating message at the right time - they create lasting engagement and value with their customers. They create a relationship of shared value. Healthcare and data are highly complex. Regulatory and compliance are absolutely necessary to protect your customers - and to protect your business. Technologies have outpaced healthcare data acumen and the business models of the last 20 yrs eliminated most healthcare data experts from the businesses of healthcare - now everyone needs more data, architecture, analytics, mgmt, and governance teams. With the patient at the heart of healthcare - we also want personalized & precision medicine. But for medicine to be truly personalized, we need to understand the ecosystems influencing patient care and the barriers these ecosystems can create for patients: health/social journeys, community and personal demographics; providers, ACOs and IDNs; payers and employers; and the local, state and federal policies affecting them. Our world of healthcare is changing at such a dramatic pace, only #ADEPT business strategies can anticipate and start building the foundational capabilities that will accelerate and exceed your business goals. Today's technology platforms, and modernized architectures can get you there... when you can define and align a Vision of People with Data - prioritized by your Business Goals: increased revenue opportunities, reduced data and tech purchase costs, robotic process automation, streamlined legal and contract reviews, Gen/AI, and full compliance by design. Be prepared... the road to real business process transformation requires a look in the mirror at "how it's always been done". ARE YOU READY? Let's Do This!

about: Prakash Agarwal has over 30 years of engineering, marketing and general management experience in the semiconductor, mobile computing, multimedia, digital imaging, digital video, digital health, wireless communications, mobile TV broadcast and consumer electronics. He has forged many key relationships with companies in Japan, Taiwan, China, Korea, Europe and USA, and enjoys personal/business relationships with key executives from these territories. Prakash was born in India and immigrated to U.S.A. in 1972 to pursue his higher studies. He holds Bachelor of Science and Masters of Science degrees in Electrical Engineering from the University of Illinois. He was a cofounder, President/CEO and a Director of NeoMagic Corp. since its inception in 1993 until April 2005. Under his leadership, NeoMagic became one of the fastest growing semiconductor company and leader in providing Multimedia Accelerators to Notebook PC market with over 60% market share and revenues of $250 million. He took NeoMagic public in March 1997 and won many prestigious awards in the industry. For two years in a row, NeoMagic won Fabless Semiconductor Association’s (FSA) award for “Best Financially Managed Company”. Additionally, NeoMagic won “The Most Respected Private Company” award in 1996 by FSA. Prakash has been recognized by several awards. Most notably he was awarded the 1998 Ernst & Young "Entrepreneur of the Year Award" for excellence and extraordinary success in innovation, financial performance, and personal commitment to his business and his community. Prakash was also a cofounder, President/CEO and a Director of iKoa Corp. from its inception until Feb. 2011. Prior to NeoMagic Prakash served as Vice President and General Manager of Cirrus Logic’s Portable Products Division. Prakash was also a Director of Zeevo Corp, a Bluetooth wireless company that he helped getting launched and funded. Zeevo was acquired by Broadcom in March 2005. Prakash is currently a member of “Industry Advisory Board” of University of Illinois, Chicago. He also served on the board of Varthana, a non banking financial corporation (NBFC) based in Bangalore providing loans to affordable private schools. He is also on the board of Crunchfull Corporation in California and Rian in Pune, India. Prakash has been very active in local and global charities through his private foundation, “The Agarwal Foundation”. Prakash is on several non-profit board both in USA and India – most notably Indians for Collective Action, US India Security Council and Akhil Bharitya Samaj Seva Sansthan.

What sets innovative, high-performing organizations apart? Can creativity and innovation be learned and enhanced? The Creative Discipline, illustrates six key factors that power creative, high-achieving organizations, and provides managers with guidelines for incorporating those factors into their own companies. Based on research on creative organizations in a range of sectors from sports to software to theater and contemporary circus, this book argues that innovative organizations known for doing things differently (and profitably) approach creativity and innovation in similar, disciplined ways, regardless of industry or field. It also shows how innovative practices in developed countries like the U.S. and Sweden compare to those in developing countries like Vietnam. Controlling for Competitiveness describes how management control is crucial in mobilizing, using, and communicating the knowledge and skills of managers and employees. Controllers should design situation-specific control systems, assuring that actions will be based on appropriate information and incentives. Enterprise systems facilitate coordination and information exchange, thus enabling the development of a consistent and congruent strategy throughout the organization. The involvement of all levels of management - as well as most employees - in this process creates motivation and commitment to the organisation's strategy. It also prepares for executing strategy through a creative use of metrics, decision tools, and clarified responsibilities. The authors underline the need to understand management control as part of the organisation's control mix (control package). They provides numerous examples of how systems and people interact in shaping a strategic focus in private as well as publicly-owned organisations. We're not just streamlining workflows. DM me for a demo and see how PocketMD can transform your practice overnight. 🤝

about: Healthcare innovator and technology executive dedicated to transforming cognitive and behavioral health through proprietary AI-driven solutions. As CEO & Founder of Scienza Health, I am building technologies that automate, personalize, and humanize patient care, provider workflow, and clinical decision-making. Our ecosystem—anchored by the patented AI-Powered Cognitive Health Assessment and Management System and Method and powered by our Digital Human® registered trademark—leverages multimodal real-time data, digital twin architecture, and streaming analytics to set a new gold standard in early detection, assessment, and management of cognitive health conditions. Our platforms empower clinicians, workplace leaders, and healthcare enterprises with: -Automated, intelligent patient screening, intake, and longitudinal monitoring -Seamless multi-modal integration, including speech, wearables, and imaging data -Workflow automation via our Digital Human® assistants, streamlining documentation, scheduling, CPT coding, and EHR integration -Intelligent clinical trial matching based on dynamic patient profiles and real-time analytics Scienza Cogniscript and our cloud-based platforms facilitate scalable and asynchronous engagement, making patient and provider experiences more effective, accurate, and personal. From clinical practice to population health and research, our innovations help drive measurable improvements in outcomes, efficiency, and accessibility. With two decades of leadership in digital health and a commitment to deploying impactful, scalable technologies, I welcome opportunities for collaboration, partnership, speaking, and advisory work at the forefront of healthcare transformation. Let’s connect if you are building, investing in, or seeking next-generation solutions for cognitive and behavioral healthcare.

publications: [{"title":"Innovative Approach: Facial Recognition and Event Related Potential for Early Detection of Alzheimer’s","subtitle":"Internation Journal of Science and Research","date":"May 21, 2024","description":"Abstract: Alzheimer's disease frequently causes impairments in facial recognition, leading to significant consequences for patients' social well-being. Moreover, facial recognition impairments in PATIENT(A) might be attributed to specific difficulties in processing face configuration, as evidenced by the absence of the typical inversion effect at the neuronal level. Additionally, fear facial expressions elicited a disproportionately large N170 response, indicating that emotional stimuli may be processed implicitly. Familiarity manipulation did not modulate the N250 in PATIENT(A) but did reveal a clear modulation of the N400 component, suggesting that long-term memory traces may be implicitly preserved. This study demonstrates the potential for advancing scientific understanding of face processing deficits in AD through the combination of in-depth individual case studies and electrophysiology. The findings highlight the importance of using electrophysiological markers in clinical practice to improve patient management, classification, and the development of targeted rehabilitation protocols for face processing deficits in AD patients."}]

recommendations: ["Sara Frucht “Jim is a genuine visionary who understands that technology is an emergent property of consciousness as it takes material form. He combines his deep understanding of technology, artificial intelligence, marketing, lifestyle and the arts into an incredibly clear vision of the dance between humans, technology and global consciousness as it moves into the future. All the trends he has talked about with me seem to be happening. He has a rare gift and an unmatched determination to bring his visions to life.”","Peter Rutten “I’ve worked with Jim on multiple projects between 1997 and 2002, most notably as a contractor for his company Xcelerator – a hands-on incubation firm that helped start-up entrepreneurs in the Bay Area with their strategy, business plan, funding, and operations. I was also involved with Jim’s extensive engagements with the Kansai Electric Power Co. (Japan), Elmic Systems (Japan/US), his own start-up ThirdNetworks, and various smaller projects. During these years, Jim and I often worked shoulder to shoulder on project execution, business plan development, fund raising, and relationship building. I’ve come to know him as an informed and inspiring entrepreneur of unmatched energy, intelligence, and integrity. I should add, given the fact that we experienced a severe setback with one very promising project due to the events of 9/11, that his bounce-back ability is remarkable. Jim knows how to build strong teams of people who excel at what they do and he navigates the treacherous waters of global business relationship building, from Japan to Sweden, with ease and with a sharp instinct as to the state of mind of the partner. But what I admire most about Jim is his ability to fire up a team, work harder than any of them, tirelessly guide them through the pitfalls, always have the interests of the stakeholders in mind at every turn of events, and the fact that he simply never gives up. Anyone who decides to work with Jim, regardless of the type of relationship, will experience, day-to-day, that he’s the brain and engine of the operation and that no stone will be left unturned to achieve success.”"]

about: As a bicoastal professional with national reach, Beth Doores brings over 20 years of leadership experience in higher education, with a strong focus on managing people, processes, and programs that foster community and innovation. Beth is known for her action-oriented approach and driving results through data-informed decision-making. Her dynamic leadership style, grounded in critical thinking, has positioned her as a trusted advisor, coach, and thought leader within academic, alumni, and professional circles. Beth has presented nationally and regionally on topics including trauma-informed coaching, mid-level management, and data-driven decision-making. Her work has earned recognition from organizations such as the National Association for Campus Activities, the National Orientation Directors Association, and Washington University in St. Louis, where she received the Student Affairs Measuring Success Award in 2021. She has also been honored for her contributions in student development, alumni engagement, as well as program/event development. A skilled connector and facilitator, Beth’s approach is rooted in relationship-building, storytelling, and shared vision, making her a catalyst for change and sustained impact.

about: Strategic Marketing & Sales Strategist | Corporate Trainer | Education Leader | EdTech Marketing Entrepreneur Ms. Wu is a strategic marketing and sales strategist, corporate trainer, education leader, and entrepreneur with over 18 years of global experience in corporate training, management consulting, international leadership development, and cross-cultural business. She is the Founder of ChronoHer, an award-winning women’s empowerment platform serving more than 35,000 mid-career Chinese women navigating global education and career transitions. Previously, as General Manager and Lead Trainer at Asher Strategies (U.S. & Asia), Ms. Wu scaled B2B sales programs and implemented enterprise-wide talent solutions impacting over 200 organizations and 100,000 professionals worldwide. Ms. Wu is recognized for her ability to build high-trust learning communities, lead cross-border partnerships, and design scalable coaching ecosystems. She holds a Master’s in Education Entrepreneurship from the University of Pennsylvania and an MBA, combining academic rigor with grassroots community impact. Her work has been widely acknowledged for excellence in public speaking, inclusive leadership, and transformative learning design. Based in Palo Alto, California, Ms. Wu invites forward-thinking leaders, innovators, and changemakers to connect and explore opportunities for mutual growth and success.

Unsolicited quote from CEO whose firm facilitated our business recapitalization. “Individually or as a couple, Kim and Chad are uniquely thoughtful people – in both senses of the word. They came to a family business to temporarily help out in a crisis and… twenty-five years later had co created a technology enabled niche industry leader. What you see is what you get: just two of the most authentic and insightful personalities I know, with a robust squirt of humor. They are positive energy creators. They may not be fully aware of this, but Bigelow lore is full of Chad and Kim stories.”

name: Rostam Zafari
position: Chief Executive Officer at World Within
about: My biggest inspiration in life has been the example of my grandfather. He helped raise me from a very young age and I still live with him today. He served as a parliamentarian in Iran when the revolution occurred, so he was forced to flee his home during the prime of his career. He was never able to have the full impact that he desired. But he’s always sought to serve humanity in whatever capacity he could. And he’s taught me that wealth exists for one reason: to better serve the world. I would love to bring the lessons he has taught me to the world of wealth. I would love to see a world where money flows to where it's most needed, not where it's most comfortable. World Within is my attempt to nudge the financial world in that direction. It’s a dream I’ve been nurturing since the age of fifteen. Our aim is to be a nonprofit fund whose mission is finding and funding the heroes of the world. By heroes we mean founders who prioritize impact over profits. We also have a foundation arm that seeks to assist the biggest innovators in the nonprofit world. This is a small beginning, but my grandfather has taught me to dream big. I’d love World Within to one day serve as a model for a better World Bank-- unbureaucratic, fast-moving, and inspiring. It’s a very distant horizon. And these are our very first steps down the path. But my hope is that each step we take can move the world a little closer to the equitable and fair society my grandfather has always envisioned. Rostam Zafari ------------------------------------------------ Rostam Zafari is the CEO of World Within, a nonprofit that funds organizations building wealth for marginalized communities, and shares their stories in order to inspire, educate, and mobilize others. He previously served as Chief Investment Officer of Sage Hill Investors (SHI), a family office based out of Chattanooga, TN. Over his career, Rostam has led nearly 200 investments in early-stage companies and fund managers across the US, India, Africa, and Europe. He advises family offices on impact investing, philanthropy, and storytelling. He is the co-creator of the TV series How to Change the World and co-founder of Bridge 4 Studios. Rostam studied poetry and social enterprise as an undergraduate at Emory University. He also received a Master’s in Development Practice while at Emory.

name: Loren Cardeli
position: Executive Director at A Growing Culture
about: Ten years ago, Loren Cardeli founded A Growing Culture (AGC), an organization that advances a culture of farmer autonomy and agroecological innovation. He believes that the key to fixing our global food system lies in giving farmers a prominent seat at the table—a seat currently threatened by the industrialization of agriculture. Having visited over 2,000 farms in more than 30 countries, Loren has a wide range of experience working with farmers in Africa, Asia, and Latin America. These experiences have provided him with an opportunity to learn innovative and sustainable farming techniques, while also helping communities tap into their own resources through the process of documenting and disseminating their agricultural practices. His work at AGC promotes farmer-led research, innovation, and knowledge sharing, helping farmers worldwide create sustainable, self-driving futures. In addition to his direct work with farmers, Loren is a seasoned public speaker, presenter, and outreach leader. Through his experience leading workshops and conducting lectures on a variety of agricultural topics, Loren has learned to conceptualize and address agricultural issues through the lens of economics, political science, and life sciences.

about: As a motivated university student with a passion for startups, technology, and psychology, I recently graduated with an International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma. My diverse academic journey has honed critical thinking, research, and communication skills, while the IB's emphasis on global-mindedness has shaped my perspective. publications: [{"title":"StEERING: A software-defined networking for inline service chaining","subtitle":"Network Protocols (ICNP), 2013 21st IEEE International Conference on","date":"October 7, 2013","description":"Network operators are faced with the challenge of deploying and managing middleboxes (also called inline services) such as firewalls within their broadband access, datacenter or enterprise networks. Due to the lack of available protocols to route traffic through middleboxes, operators still rely on error-prone and complex low-level configurations to coerce traffic through the desired set of middleboxes. Built upon the recent software-defined networking (SDN) architecture and OpenFlow protocol, this paper proposes StEERING, short for SDN inlinE sERvices and forwardlNG. It is a scalable framework for dynamically routing traffic through any sequence of middleboxes. With simple centralized configuration, StEERING can explicitly steer different types of flows through the desired set of middleboxes, scaling at the level of per-subscriber and per-application policies. With its capability to support flexible routing, we further propose an algorithm to select the best locations for placing services, such that the performance is optimized. Overall, StEERING allows network operators to monetize their middlebox deployment in new ways by allowing subscribers flexibly to select available network services."},{"title":"Book on \"Advanced Internet Protocols, Services, and Applications\"","subtitle":"John Wiley","date":"Apr 2012"},{"title":"Design and Implementation of OpenFlow-Based MPLS Controller for Access/Aggregation Networks","subtitle":"ISOCORE","date":"October 1, 2011"},{"title":"Design Considerations for Next Generation IPv6 Based Virtual Private Networks","subtitle":"Annual Review of Communications:, Volume 59, International Engineering Consortium","date":"Nov 2005"},{"title":"Multimedia Communications Networks Technologies and Services","subtitle":"Artech House Publishers","date":"Jun 1998"}]

about: Nate MacLeitch, a seasoned business professional boasting over two decades of diverse industry experience, including telecom, media, software, and technology, was drawn into the realm of digital communication solutions in the early 2010s. Recognizing the fading relevance of older communication methods with the advent of smartphones and app stores, he envisioned a future where communication would be dynamic, convenient, media-rich, and cost-effective. Teaming up with seasoned developers, they forged a path to revolutionize mobile applications with SDKs and APIs, enabling features like chat, video calling, file sharing, and push notifications. This venture bloomed into QuickBlox, of which Nate became the proud sole owner and CEO in July 2018. Since then, Nate has been at the helm, diligently reshaping the company, assembling a top-notch team of developers and operational managers, and strengthening operations in the UK. Their customer base has swelled to over 500 worldwide, a testament to the appeal of QuickBlox's offerings. Furthermore, the company has broadened its product portfolio, venturing into ready-made solutions. In 2020, they introduced Q-Consultation, a private video calling app with virtual meeting rooms and instant messaging. In 2023, QuickBlox unveiled Q-Consultation Lite, a streamlined version of the original, providing pre-built chat apps complete with user interfaces. Presently, they're forging ahead with a suite of cutting-edge AI-enhanced communication tools and integrations. Beyond his corporate endeavors, Nate is a dedicated mentor and investor in startups, having guided ventures like Springboard Mobile and TechStars. He holds degrees from the University of California, Davis, and The London School of Economics and Political Science. Although rooted in California, Nate spent 16 enriching years in London with his wife and children. In 2016, they made the choice to return to California, where Nate revels in being part of the vibrant tech community in Silicon Valley. Additionally, he finds solace and inspiration in tending to his vineyards in Northern California. Feel free to connect and message Nate if you'd like to learn more about QuickBlox and its innovative solutions.

name: Anastasia Totok
position: Global Impact Award Winner | Founder & CEO Humantica — AI Leadership Copilot | We don’t replace leaders, we make them stronger
about: I’m the founder of Humantica — your AI leadership copilot. We take the burden off leaders by detecting and resolving the issues that cause team burnout, disengagement, and turnover. At the same time, we give every employee a sense of visibility, support, and continuous growth. With 20+ years in leadership consulting, I’ve seen the true cost of disengagement – and the transformation that happens when people feel connected again. That inspired me to create Humantica: combining human intelligence with AI to deliver consulting-level impact at scale, boost ROI, and help people rediscover joy and growth at work. My approach blends MIT’s Theory U and Social Presencing Theater with the latest breakthroughs in neuroscience, sociology, physics, psychology, and data science. This unique methodology has powered transformation for organizations across the U.S., Europe, and Asia — from fast-growing startups to global enterprises. In 2024, I was honored as a finalist of the Women Changing the World Awards for Global Impact and Migrant Leadership. Let’s connect if you’re shaping teams, culture, or the Future of Work.

about: A technology evangelist, entrepreneur, thought leader, and speaker based in San Francisco, California. I am currently working with a few of Microsoft's largest customers in Silicon Valley to shape the future use of AI. I daily advise senior business executives and aide their teams in the use and deployment of data, cloud, and AI across many use-cases and industries. My colleagues say I'm "truly in the thick" of this new AI transformation with an intimate, hands-on knowledge of what is really happening now and what is expected to evolve for the future of AI. I am a gifted storyteller with the ability to translate complex concepts into real-world terms so people and businesses can take action and ultimately recognize the "art of the possible" with these new technologies. I frequently speak at events related to high-tech topics and evangelize on the future of AI, agentic systems, autonomous systems, data, and cloud and how these technologies will shape companies and ultimately impact people in our daily lives. I currently serve as the board president for the Association of Corporate Growth – Silicon Valley Chapter (acg.org/sv) and advise start-ups, venture capital firms, private equity investors, investment bankers, and operating companies on how to leverage new technologies during merger and acquisition (M&A) activities. Personally, I have founded and successfully exited three start-up businesses and serve as a board advisor for start-ups giving me a real understanding of the M&A space. I hold an Aerospace Engineering (BSAE) degree from the University of Alabama. In my personal life, I a former combat engineering officer in the US Army and a current member of the 82nd Airborne Division Association. I enjoy fly fishing, skiing, travel, on-line gaming, cosplay, and trying new cuisines. A sample of my speaking engagements includes: - The Silicon Valley Podcast - Association of Corporate (acg.org) - ACG DealMax Conference - Microsoft Technology Center events - Intel business conferences - NXP national conference - Cloudera conferences - Cisco conferences - Computer History Museum - Churchill's Group conferences - Silicon Valley Business Times - San Francisco Business Times - IEEE National Conference

about: I am focused on building a world we would be happy to be born into at random. A few years ago, I formed a group called Elea Collective: our members are post-exit founders, serial entrepreneurs, and families committed to channeling their capital and talent toward meaningful impact. Prior to Elea, I co-founded and exited World Within, a holding company forming & investing in companies with breakthrough technologies. World Within is now a nonprofit platform focused on filming and funding exceptional social entrepreneurs. My unique view into the possibilities and limits of markets has led me to advise other entrepreneurs, family principals, and philanthropists dedicated to transforming their wealth into meaningful impact. For several years I chaired the board of the Emory Global Health Institute. I also serve on the boards of Generation Pledge and a family office based in Brazil. Outside of work, I have a parallel career as a poet. My writing has been supported by a Breadloaf Scholarship and appears in Narrative, the Southern Humanities Review, and Northwest Review. I travel often and am based between NYC and Atlanta.

name: Rajnesh (Raj) Singh
position: CEO @ APNIC Foundation | Empower. Innovate. Transform. | Driving digital development in the Asia Pacific to catalyse socio-economic development, and the next generation of technologists, innovators & changemakers
about: Serial entrepreneur (largely retired from that life). Now focused on increasing investment in digital development in the Asia Pacific to catalyse social and economic development, and the next generation of technologists, innovators and changemakers. Played founding and leading roles in several technology and private equity investment firms. Extensive experience in business management and strategy development across multiple industries, including ICT, telecommunications, power infrastructure, agriculture, manufacturing and real estate. Provided consulting and mentoring support to start-ups and SMEs in the Asia-Pacific region, and held advisory roles across multiple sectors ranging from governmental organisations to sporting organisations and the private sector. Extensive experience with the technology and Internet sector. Held several leadership roles, including Chair of the Asia-Pacific Regional Internet Governance Forum (APrIGF) and Founding Chair of ICANN’s Asia Pacific Regional At-Large Organisation (APRALO). Served on Advisory Boards and Expert Working Groups for regional and international organisations, including UN agencies, on infrastructure, policy and regulatory reform, and development issues. Broad experience in the Asia-Pacific region and beyond with a demonstrated ability to deliver in diverse and dynamic environments. Consummate relationship builder. Highly adept at working with diverse groups of people in an international multicultural environment, and providing leadership to reach collective objectives. Multi-lingual with extensive knowledge of the Asia-Pacific region - and its nuances.

name: Francisco Marin
position: Founder & CEO at Cognitive Talent Solutions | Founding Member of the Network-First Manifesto
about: Francisco Marin is the Founder and CEO of Cognitive Talent Solutions (CTS) and a Founding Member of the Network-First Manifesto, a global initiative advocating for a shift from rigid hierarchies to network-based models of work. Based in Palo Alto, Francisco leads CTS, a company at the forefront of AI-powered Organizational Network Analysis (ONA). Under his leadership, CTS has supported Fortune 500 companies such as Thermo Fisher Scientific, Coca-Cola, and CBRE in enhancing talent strategies, optimizing organizational structures, and improving collaboration dynamics. Recognized by RedThread Research and Everest Group as a leading People Analytics vendor, CTS was named the Best Innovative Solution in Talent Analytics at the 2025 HR Tech Awards. With over a decade of experience in AI and People Analytics, Francisco has been instrumental in advancing network science in corporate settings. He co-developed the first generation of AI agents for People Analytics, including eight patent-pending AI agents covering use cases like onboarding, change management, and organizational development. He has also led strategic partnerships with ServiceNow and Google, making CTS the only ONA provider with direct integration routes into mainstream enterprise ecosystems. Through the Network-First Manifesto, Francisco unites leaders and organizations to shape a future of work built on collaborative freedom, trust, and social capital. Before founding CTS, Francisco worked as a Business Analytics Leader at IBM, deploying AI-powered solutions for process automation and predictive talent retention on a global scale. He holds a Master’s Degree in Business Administration from Loyola University and is a certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, with expertise in Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, and Design Thinking methodologies. Francisco is also the Co-Founder of the People Analytics Society (PAS) under DCH, an international association of HR executives with more than 4,000 members across 12 countries, where he serves as an Ambassador in the US. He is a frequent speaker at industry conferences and academic institutions, contributing thought leadership on ONA, AI agents, and social capital strategies. Fluent in English, Spanish, Slovak, and Japanese, he has worked across North America, Asia, and Europe to help organizations become more agile, meritocratic, and resilient.

about: We are in a hundred year period of profound change, where our relationship with technology is redefining what it means to be human. As architects of our digital world, we have an opportunity to shape the future. I love consumer facing applications, and designing and developing all the technologies to bring a product to market. I typically join startups early and have learned to wear many hats. I'm happy being an individual contributor working on hard problems, but I am almost always pulled into engineering and product management to help drive our teams. I have a broad and deep understanding of the technologies used to deliver scalable mobile online user experiences and am an active developer. My current favorite mix is React for iOS/Android/Web, AWS (Lambda, SQS, SES, RDS/MySQL, S3, Cloudfront, CloudWatch, VPC, Route53), and of course AI (OpenAI, Llama, Gemini, Groq, etc.). I was lucky to have joined Nuance Communications pre-IPO and helped build an AI powered natural language voice assistant in 2000 that helped Nuance IPO. A few years later I was back at SRI helping launch Tempo.AI which was later acquired by Salesforce. I'm into my third AI groove now which has landed me at the intersection of peer-to-peer Agentic AI and the quickly growing ecosystem of AI agents. Soon, everyone will have a cadre of agents to do their bidding and improve the quality of both their personal and business lives. Soon we will all have the tools to "Live long and prosper". Exciting times are ahead!

Chaymaa is passionate about marketing, storytelling, and entrepreneurship, and constantly seeks to learn new skills and grow professionally and personally. Owing to her diverse set of talents, she also tends to spend the majority of her leisure time reading, writing, blogging and sketching.

about: I’m Victoria Bracha, the creator of VB Fine Chocolates. I’ve traveled around the world enjoying fine dining and chocolates. I love to reverse engineer the gourmet dishes I’ve had and try to recreate them. Having tasted many luxury and artisanal chocolates in my travels, and still feeling that something was missing, I finally decided to create my own. With my experience as a fashion designer, having owned and operated a women’s apparel business with vertical integration of design, manufacture, wholesale, and retail for 15 years, I create my chocolate pieces like fashion collections. Each collection has a visual theme, in this case, a specific shape with a coherent flavor flow using Belgian white or dark chocolate. People often tell me that my chocolates are too pretty to eat. I want people to think that these chocolates are so pretty that they have to try some. We eat with our eyes before we even taste our food. During our overseas trips, my family and I dined in many Michelin-starred restaurants. I am often thrilled by how elegantly and colorfully the dishes are plated, and how unique and exquisite they taste. I am striving to create chocolates of that caliber. I find it challenging and joyful to keep creating new seasonal collections while maintaining a high standard. My mission is to bring sweetness and smiles to people’s lives!

about: Vinod Cherian Joseph is a Senior Director and Head of the Open Innovations Group at Samsung Research America. He has been instrumental in commercial partnerships, new product innovation, and executing concepts from ideation to launch. He has extensive Mobile and Consumer product experience towards services, go-to-market strategy, competitive analysis, and driving ideas through partnerships, collaboration, startup incubation, and strategic business development. He holds B.Tech. from Bangalore Institute of Technology; Masters from Wollongong University, NSW; and has studied Ph.D. in Management of Technology at SKKU. He is a recipient of several awards for distinguished contributions in the fields of ‘Technology Management’ and ‘Mobile Communication’, respectively. He has authored 20+ IEEE Journal and Conference papers and holds 8 US Patents. He led the Industry’s first LTE chipset development and release on Android Mobile/Tablet and was active in 3GPP, IETF Standards bodies. He was involved in the early OI activities at DMC R&D, setting up CTO Office at SRI-B and led many critical projects for Samsung across Korea, India and Middle East regions before his tenure in the Americas region. He currently leads an environment necessary to foster and sustain long-term profitable growth in which people can seize opportunities, take risks, make mistakes and generate new ideas. He has extensive leadership experience across geographies to identify consumer pain-points, market insights and business needs and formulate strategy with partners to deliver solutions to delight users.

about: Career Experience James has worked in the Silicon Valley high technology industry since 1983. During his first eighteen years he worked at Intel Corporation where he gained broad experience in a variety of sales, marketing and venture capital positions. In August of 2001 James left Intel to form Matrix Solutions LLC, a consulting practice focused primarily on product strategy, channel “go to market” programs and organizational best practices. Since 2002, Matrix Solutions has successfully completed 48 projects for 26 unique clients with a 100% rehire rate. James is adept at linking company and product strategy to marketing and sales programs while quantitatively tracking results. By utilizing this approach James is able to develop practical strategies and programs to drive profitable revenue growth. In 2010 James joined InterAct Public Safety (renamed InterAct in 2012) to participate in a company rescue led John McNulty currently President/CEO of InterAct. Since joining the company revenue has grown 7X the public safety market CAGR, two target acquisitions have been completed and new funding raised from existing and new investors.

about: Irakli Kashibadze is the Founder and Managing Partner of Future Laboratory Ventures, the first VC fund in Georgia. VC fund investing in Georgian startups with US-focused products. FLV is partnering with UC Berkeley in process of preparing startups for the US market. Irakli Kashibadze is also CEO and Founder of Future Laboratory, a company specializing in innovation and digital transformation management. Before launching Future Laboratory and Future Laboratory Ventures, Irakli was the founding Chairman of Georgia's Innovation and Technology Agency and served as the Secretary General of the Council for Innovation and Education under the Prime Minister of Georgia. He has a proven track record in the information technology, telecommunications, and innovation industries. As a skilled business development professional, Irakli's expertise spans business planning, complex problem-solving, innovation management, and startup development. With over ten years of leadership experience in government, he has spearheaded numerous state initiatives aimed at fostering an information society, enhancing innovation, developing startup ecosystems, and advancing the "Broadband for All" program.

about: Hi, I’m Dimitriy Wolf a Communication Coach, Social Scientist, and Entrepreneur with over 15 years of experience. I’ve dedicated my career to mastering the art of communication at the intersection of speech, social skills, and brain science. Throughout my journey, I’ve had the privilege of coaching top leaders from Europe and the U.S., including politicians, celebrities, and musicians, helping them perfect their public speaking and enhance their presence. One of the highlights of my career was sharing the stage with Volodymyr Zelensky in 2019, which further established my influence in the field. My path hasn’t been linear. I’ve experienced life on both ends of the spectrum—from culturally rich environments to poverty and social isolation. Frequent relocations and challenging family dynamics pushed me to adapt quickly, giving me unique insights into communication, resilience, and human adaptability. These life experiences shaped my understanding of societal norms, limitations, and overcoming adversity. Since 2008, I’ve been teaching Communication Science, specializing in public speaking, pitching, and self-presentation. I’ve prepared investment pitches, with one client successfully raising $30 million in just five minutes. Whether on stage with state leaders or coaching clients one-on-one, my focus is always on helping others communicate more effectively. As a lecturer at Singularity University Kyiv, I specialize in AI for EdTech, helping businesses navigate the challenges and opportunities of emerging technologies. At SmartExpert.io and ContentBuilder.ai, I co-own and lead Learning & Development, where we automate education through AI, making learning more accessible, engaging, and efficient. I value brutal honesty, transparency, and exceeding expectations in everything I do. Outside of work, you’ll find me captaining yachts, collecting antique books, exploring history and astronomy, or honing my skills in historical fencing.

publications: [{"title":"3D Printing of Polymers with Continuous Fibers to Replace Steel Reinforcement and Structural Steel in Construction","subtitle":"ASTM International","date":"February 26, 2022","description":"Three dimensional (3D) printing technology has the potential for reshaping the construction industry. Despite advances in 3D concrete printing, the majority of construction applications still require structural steel or steel reinforcement in order to achieve code compliance. Development of polymer-based high-filled composite with a fiber reinforcement can be a better alternative to the cementitious composite for 3D printing while providing better strength and durability. These materials can be used in various civil engineering applications, including slab on grades, precast architectural panels, facade construction, and more. The current paper gives a first insight into the application of the newly developed polymer-based composite and 3D printing technology, combining composite extrusion, ultraviolet curing, and continuous glass fiber reinforcement. In this case, the fiber, which has been saturated with the organic binder, is laid out layer by layer on top of the extruded layer of the composite. Thus, the high adhesion between the matrix and the fiber is achieved. This study presents the current capabilities of 3D-printed structures with continuous fibers to eliminate steel reinforcement and structural steel in residential buildings. Advantages of the developed 3D printing technology amidst 3D concrete printing are described. The study also provides methods to evaluate the strength and durability of 3D-printed structures."},{"title":"Material Development Standards and Methods for Additive Manufacturing in Construction to Meet Building Code Requirements for Certification","subtitle":"ASTM International","date":"February 26, 2022","description":"A major challenge of applying AM to regulated industries is that the resulting printed material(s) have to meet the requirements of those particular applications. Unfortunately, for many novel applications of AM, there are not yet standards in place to provide a framework for ensuring those requirements are met. The construction industry has very high standards for materials and methods of manufacturing—for example, one- or two-hour fire ratings and low thermal conductivity. Traditional buildings, structures, and building components include an exterior member, an interior member, and a plurality of cross members between them where each member is formed with different materials that should perform together as one system or subsystem. With AM, the volumetric building or building component can be formed from a multi layer stack of three-dimensionally printable material designed with fire rating, thermal conductivity, and other requirements in mind. Such printed structures can be monolithically integrated, which is a significant advantage for materials with low thermal conductivity as it allows the elimination of dozens of manufacturing and assembly operations used in traditional buildings. An outer surface region of such a printed structure can form the final surface finish, either by itself or with some overlying finish or a protective layer added. The structure can have cavities for a fill material deposited into openings between the exterior and interior members. Large-scale three-dimensional printing machines should be equipped with sensors and logging systems to ensure the quality and consistency of the printing process. This paper explores the use of AM in the construction of buildings and proposes a model for ensuring quality starting at the point of material development and continuing through to completion—the purpose of which is to create greater efficiency and uptake in the novel use of AM in construction and other highly regulated industries."}]

about: My career started with a why not? Why not skip the safe route and chase something wildly different? I moved to Ghana right after college with no connections and pretty rough English. That turned into selling tires out of shipping containers and launching e-commerce ventures from scratch. I eventually built startups across Africa, Asia, and the U.S. My journey as a founder in Africa humbled me. It taught me grit, resilience, and how to figure things out fast when nothing goes according to plan. The same why-not spirit and deep curiosity led me to the Bay Area and eventually pulled me into the world of venture capital. I love learning, I love working with founders, and I always go all in for the people bold enough to build what others think is impossible.

recommendations: ["Andrés Ospina “Working under Rick's leadership was a career and life-changing experience for me. I reported under Rick's oversight for over two years at RBC and later at CNB. During our time at RBC, he gave me the challenge, vision, space, and support to develop a Design Thinking consulting start-up for RBC Global Wealth Management Technology and Operations group that we called \"Xperience First\"; this internal consulting team transformed the way the WM business strategized experiences for our UHNW and HNW clients, their Investment Advisors and the RBC colleagues that supported their business operations. Rick demonstrated that bringing an end-to-end Human-Centered Design approach to technology and operations is possible by leading the charge to change an organization's culture with thousands of colleagues in a wide range of cross-functional roles. Rick is a visionary leader who is unafraid to think big and bold. He fosters and champions empathy in ways that are rare to find among technology and banking leaders. But more importantly, he's a very human, compassionate, and approachable leader who makes everyone on his team feel cherished. Any organization, executive, manager, and practitioner would be fortunate to work with Rick.”","Jo Ann Tan “I have known and worked with Rick for over 2 years at City National Bank where he built an IT culture centered on transformation and innovation. He encouraged his team to design creative, differentiated business solutions and employed modern delivery practices for agility and speed. Rick always pushed the boundaries of what’s possible. He led with a vision and collaborated with his leadership team to execute, which together delivered unparalleled results to the business. His sponsorship for cloud, digitization, data capabilities/AI, automation and modernization across the Bank’s major initiatives similarly garnered recognition from strategic partners and industry leaders. I have only known a handful of dynamic and forward-thinking leaders, and Rick is unquestionably one of them.”"]

about: Peter is Founder & CEO of Kindling, a video-based, online mentorship platform that empowers young adults with the skills, tools, and mindsets they need to thrive personally and professionally. He brings 30 years of experience in advertising, sales and marketing, including 21 years at ESPN. Peter worked with some of the most powerful brands in the world and has had the great fortune of working for some of the most visionary and creative minds in Corporate America, including Bob Iger, Ted Turner, and George Bodenheimer. His extensive experience in interviewing, hiring, training, and mentoring young adults has prepared him well for this important responsibility and personal calling. Peter graduated from Villanova University with a business degree in marketing and was captain of the varsity tennis team. He lives in Philadelphia with his wife, author Kat Yeh, and they have two adult children. For more on Kindling, please check out our website, gokindling.com.
